verdict.rationale: Runway documents generating video from text, an image, or a clip, along with video-to-video and image-to-video modes. Seedance 2.5 adds a large reference budget for images, videos and audio, so reference-driven generation is a first-party capability. That 'new footage' keeps the reference's style is implied rather than stated. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of style transfer from a reference, detail on how references control style, and independent or hands-on corroboration of style-faithful results.
